```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-old-bot-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Build close-old-bot-discussions binary
        run: |
          go build -o close-old-bot-discussions ./cmd/close-old-bot-discussions

      - name: Run close-old-bot-discussions
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          ./close-old-bot-discussions
```
